classes.label: 네일 사진
prompts: A close-up photograph of a manicure on fingernails.
A photo of hands with decorated gel nails.
A set of artificial nail tips with nail art.

classes.label: 네일 외 사진
prompts: A photo of a landscape, food, or everyday objects without fingernails.
A portrait of a face without any visible fingernails.
A document, screenshot, or price list with text.

classes.label: 맨손톱 · 소재 확인
prompts: A close-up of bare natural fingernails without nail polish.
A manicure with clear transparent nail polish on natural nails.
Short natural fingernails with no nail art.

classes.label: 원컬러 · 시럽
prompts: A manicure with plain solid color glossy gel nail polish.
Fingernails painted with translucent jelly syrup nail polish.
A simple manicure with smooth plain pink gel polish and ordinary reflections.

classes.label: 자석젤 · 캣아이
prompts: A manicure with magnetic cat eye gel polish and a luminous band of light on each fingernail.

Magnetic gel nail polish with a bright curved cat eye light stripe and dark edges.

classes.label: 그라데이션
prompts: A manicure with ombre gradient gel nail polish fading from pink to white.
